text: Figure 11.34: Security protocol configuration With this modeling approach it is possible to configure different security protocol settings for the communication over TCP , UDP and multicast. For example it is allowed to use different settings to protect the TCP communication of a AdaptivePlatformServiceInstance via TLS and UDP communication via DTLS. Please note that protection of IP multicast traffic is only supported by SecOC and therefore the ServiceInstanceToMachineMapping refers directly the SecOcSecureComProps in the secOcComPropsForMulticast role.
